rows.why: Crisper contrast makes the path, obstacles, and surrounding landmarks easier to read.
Less haze and stronger color separation make distant obstacles and scenery clearer.
The hero and yellow pickups stand out more clearly, and the forest looks richer without the pale haze.
Visible movement and jump controls make play clearer, while the hero and platform gaps remain easy to see.
The overhead view clearly shows the ball, hole, course boundaries, and obstacles.
The central marker and yellow platform are easier to see, with less obstruction from the foreground crystal.
Stronger contrast separates the ground, pickup, and basket, while the overhead foliage sits clear of the HUD.
The centered approach and clearer spacing of the foreground hazards make the hero and enemy line slightly easier to read.
